prompt:
Create ONE FIRST ART-STYLE TEST for Giger Machine's game story, landscape16:9, no panels or lettering.
Reference1 is DRAWING STYLE ONLY: unfinished beginner sketch on clean WHITE background, thin irregular black pencil/pen contours, visible loose RED construction sketch lines and a few BLUE/VIOLET guide strokes, overlapping exploratory lines and un-erased rough shapes. Large white unpainted areas, a few hesitant details, uneven modest draughtsmanship. NOT a finished colored illustration, not crayon/gouache, no shading or professional crosshatching, no digital metal rendering, not a technical blueprint. Make entire scene in SAME rough sketch language, not just the protagonist.
Reference2 is the ACTUAL GIGER MACHINE LOCOMOTIVE IDENTITY ONLY, not its render style or tan colors. Giger Machine IS THE LOCOMOTIVE ITSELF, no humanoid hero or driver. Preserve its squat elongated steam engine body, FOUR large spoked side wheels with connecting rod, large cylindrical rear boiler and short rear stack, an enormous elongated oval ribbed BRAIN-LIKE biomechanical dome spanning the top front, two long thin pointed ivory horn/brow spikes extending horizontally from dome, one little dark eye on either side of blunt rectangular snout, very wide rectangular grin/jaw with TWO rows of square metallic teeth, rectangular front buffer. Identity must resemble reference2 with a slight monster pose, not a generic train, not a pumpkin monster, not a humanoid and not an alien octopus. Simplify mechanical construction but retain recognizable silhouette and original engine proportions. Do not exaggerate to a tiny chibi toy.
Scene for the opening: Giger Machine charges along a short crooked rail in Pscoworld, three-quarter front/side view facing right, main engine occupying central upper-middle of canvas. Its toothy jaw is open slightly as it crushes one simple foreign metal crate at the front buffer, a few angular fragments thrown forward, energetic scribbled motion arcs. The brain dome and wheel circles have obvious RED exploratory construction curves under black contours, BLUE/VIOLET guide lines around rods and rail perspective. In the sparse background only two crooked mushroom shapes, one floating eye drawn as a crude oval and a little spiraling doorway suggest the mad world. No busy landscape, no full-color fills, no realistic scenery, no gore, no other characters. Keep plenty of blank white space, rough unfinished sketch. Bottom fifth mostly clear for future dialogue. Reference1 sketch's organic loose construction feel applied to the whole train and background, avoid polished vector lineart.
status: First style test awaiting user feedback. No campaign implementation or live story replacement.
